Package org.apache.juneau.http.part

Class HttpPartList.Unmodifiable

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<E>
java.util.AbstractList<E>
java.util.ArrayList<HttpPart>
org.apache.juneau.http.part.HttpPartList
org.apache.juneau.http.part.HttpPartList.Unmodifiable
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, Iterable<HttpPart>, Collection<HttpPart>, List<HttpPart>, RandomAccess, UnmodifiableBean
Enclosing class:
HttpPartList
public static class HttpPartList.Unmodifiable extends HttpPartList implements UnmodifiableBean
An unmodifiable snapshot of a HttpPartList.

This is the D4 "collection-mutator-override" variant of the immutability paradigm. Because HttpPartList extends ArrayList, a single funnel cannot intercept the inherited ArrayList mutators, so this subclass snapshot-copies the elements in its constructor and overrides the entire collection-mutator surface — its own fluent mutators plus the inherited ArrayList mutators (including the iterator() / listIterator() mutators) — to throw UnsupportedOperationException. Read operations and non-mutating iteration continue to work.
